recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有兩個細胞質淡粉紅、含顆粒碎屑與空泡的巨噬細胞，周圍緊密圍繞著一圈核圓、染色質濃縮、細胞質深藍的紅血球前驅細胞，形成雙中心的紅血球島（erythroblastic island，俗稱 nurse cell）。
features: Two central macrophages with ill-defined pale pink-violet granular cytoplasm containing vacuoles and phagocytosed debris
Numerous erythroid precursors clustered around and upon the macrophage cytoplasm in a rosette-like island
Erythroblasts are round with high N:C ratio, round nuclei with coarse condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Precursors appear at similar maturation stages (mainly basophilic to polychromatic normoblasts) without megaloblastic change
Background of red cells; slightly thick area with blue-green tint limits fine detail
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive erythroblastic island centered on two macrophages with pale granular cytoplasm containing vacuoles and phagocytic debris. The macrophages are surrounded by numerous erythroid precursors, predominantly basophilic and polychromatic normoblasts with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. No megaloblastic or dyserythropoietic features, hemophagocytosis of intact cells, or atypical cells are evident. Findings are consistent with normal erythroblastic islands (nurse cells) of active erythropoiesis.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are cohesive with nuclear molding, fine chromatin and lack a central macrophage, whereas erythroid islands show maturing normoblasts around a histiocyte.
In hemophagocytosis intact erythroblasts, red cells or leukocytes are engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm, not merely clustered around it.
Lymphocytes have scant pale blue cytoplasm and clumped chromatin without the deep basophilia and progressive hemoglobinization of normoblasts.
